title: The injective comparison preserves the cochain section unit
statement: Let f:X→S be a morphism of schemes, F a module sheaf on X, I an injective resolution of F, q a natural number and V an open of S. Use the raw injective comparison b_f [def-weil-pbc-square-resolution-roof-models] on f inverse V, and the natural section unit [def-weil-pbc-direct-image-section-unit]. Then b_f.hom followed by local hypercohomology of Rf_*(Q(I.ι′)) at V is directImageSectionUnitAt(f,q,V,I.cochainComplex). This statement concerns a single resolution and has no commuting square, coefficient morphism or roof denominator.

proof.text: The integer extension of the nonnegative injective resolution is K-injective. Write r=asIso(Q(I.ι′)). Write z for homology of the inverse-open model comparison at this integer extension, followed by homologyFunctorFactors. The inverse-open cochain unit at the extension is the inverse of that model comparison.

Let R be inverse-open hypercohomology and T be local hypercohomology after Rf_*. The natural comparison l:R→T has component topEdgeLocalLeray inverse. Unfolding b_f gives the exact evaluation/homology comparison followed by evaluation of z inverse, R(r inverse), and l at F[0]. Postcompose by T(r). Naturality of l at r inverse and functoriality cancel T(r inverse);T(r). What remains is exactly the definition of the evaluated cochain unit. This calculation works for zero resolutions, empty opens and q=0.

lean.statement:
theorem injectiveSectionUnit_comparison {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    (F : X.Modules) (q : ℕ) (V : S.Opens) (I : InjectiveResolution F) :
    (squareInjectiveLocalComparison f F q V I (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) rfl).hom ≫
      ((RingedSpace.localHypercohomologyPresheaf S.toRingedSpace (q : ℤ)).map
        ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).map (DerivedCategory.Q.map I.ι'))).app (op V) =
      directImageSectionUnitAt f (q : ℤ) V I.cochainComplex
